$comment: Steam depot ids for tools\release-steam.ps1 (Roadmap 10.2). Fill these in from the Steamworks partner site once the App ID exists. IDs are NOT secrets - the Steam account password / 2FA never lives here (release-steam.ps1 takes the login interactively or from a cached steamcmd session).
$branchNote: Empty = upload the build but do NOT set it live. Set to 'default' only when you actually mean to publish to everyone; use a named beta branch (e.g. 'alpha') while testing.
